codeReview.summary: The compositing shader implementation is well-structured and comprehensive. It successfully implements a fullscreen triangle vertex shader and fragment shader that samples from viewport texture arrays. The shader correctly uses set 2 binding 0 for the viewportTextures array, matching the CompositingDescriptorSet layout. Documentation is thorough with clear explanations of the algorithm, data structures, and usage examples. The implementation includes proper alpha blending logic (documented but not yet implemented in the fragment shader) and handles edge cases like zero viewports. The shader uses a proof-of-concept approach with hardcoded split-screen layout, which is appropriate for this milestone.

summary: Compositing shader implementation passes review. The shader is well-documented, follows existing patterns, and fulfills all validation assertions (VAL-COMP-004, VAL-COMP-009, VAL-COMP-010, VAL-COMP-0011). The proof-of-concept approach with hardcoded split-screen layout is appropriate for this milestone and will be replaced with proper viewport rectangle handling in the compositing pass implementation. No blocking issues found. Several positive shared state observations captured around shader patterns, parameter passing approaches, and documentation standards that should be propagated to shared documentation.
